notes: Site-owned What’s New rows (site features and podcast). Book published/revised events come from after-certainty changeEvents.

events.title: Songs from After Certainty
events.summary: Ideas from the project now live as music you can play on the site — jazz, folk, soul, electronic, psychedelia, and more. Start on Listen, or explore how each song connects to books, concepts, and patterns.

events.title: Podcast: How Meaning Moves
events.summary: A companion episode walking through Signal, Compression, Restraint, and Connection as the through-line.

events.title: Start with a Question
events.summary: Curated question paths help visitors enter the commons through a lived tension rather than a catalog shelf alone.

events.title: Reading Trails
events.summary: Editorial trails sequence books, concepts, and patterns into short guided paths across the project.

events.title: Read online
events.summary: Published books can now be read on the site chapter by chapter, with stable links from book pages, search, and reading paths.

events.title: Listen to books
events.summary: Some published books now include chapter narration you can play while reading. Open Observer Patterns’ introduction to try the audio player.
